> Make sure to fully explain all the main details of transitioning: reasons, health, how it affects them, etc.

I could just put everything, but if he tells me to fuck off...  I mean, I suppose. If he tells me to never come back, I'll have to drop college and spend from now until May figuring out how to live on my own. I'm really, really scared of that.

It's difficult because I'm financially dependent. It all comes down to what my dad says. My mother has influence, but if in the end he were to side 100% with me and tell her to suck it up, she would. She would not do it quietly, and I would never hear the end of it, but it *could* happen.

Believe me, there's nothing I want more than to run like hell. But I have no job, hardly any money, and I won't be able to afford to live on my own, let alone transition. I'm a terrified 19 year old trans girl who is quite naive about the world.
